## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it addresses.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / CI

## Verification

- [ ] Ran relevant tests (`mvn clean verify` where possible)
- [ ] Checked authorization behavior for affected endpoints
- [ ] Checked validation and error responses
- [ ] Confirmed no secrets or personal data were added
- [ ] Updated documentation or configuration examples

## Risk and rollback

Describe any schema, configuration, or compatibility risk and how to roll back safely.

## Screenshots / logs

Add screenshots or sanitized logs when useful. Never include credentials or personal data.
